title.narrative: Medical Education Education w. Maastricht University Phase 2

description.narrative: In 2021, Cordaid reached out to SHE Collaborates (SHEC), the office for international collaboration and consultancy of the School of Health Professions Education (SHE) at Maastricht University, with the question if we were involved in the developments of improving teaching methods for higher education; either with research or implementation? The answer was a resounding “yes” as SHEC offers a tailored approach to innovative training and consulting in the areas of education, management and research on a global scale. In doing so, SHE Collaborates capitalizes on Maastricht University’s nearly 50 years of experience in implementing student-centered learning in medicine and health sciences. It is SHE Collaborates’ goal to promote improvement in health professions education practices worldwide through collaboration with partners from a variety of disciplines, educational backgrounds and cultures. The exploratory conversations soon became more concrete and at the end of 2021 it was decided to start a pilot collaboration, with the focus on changing the narrative of health professions education in Sierra Leone.
Participants from health professions training institutes that enroll in the Health Professional Education-course
